system.effect:
Prerequisites: @UUID[Compendium.ptu.references.Item.c3orXGvBR10ScFbZ]
Daily – Standard Action
Effect: For the next five minutes, all light within 10m of you is extinguished, leaving only a black void surrounding you. It is considered Blocking Terrain for the purposes of line of sight for anyone without @UUID[Compendium.ptu.capabilities.Item.zzJWpOj40dLelBm5] or @UUID[Compendium.ptu.capabilities.Item.vA7vGdfceeDzi5sc], and anyone without either Capability suffers from Total Blindness while within. The @UUID[Compendium.ptu.capabilities.Item.v4OOr4KlIO0DKw5r] Capability and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.abilities.Item.3Nfs8PnPBHaTiUfU] Ability are disabled while within, and any moves that grant Glow may not be used. While this effect is active, you may not use Standard Actions. Ending this effect is a Swift Action.
